prepare_contribution_review.description: Review the data that will be included in the contribution for {device}. Product: `{product_id}` · category: `{category}` · protocol: `{protocol_version}` · entities: {entity_count}. Observed DPS: `{observed_dps}`. Required DPS: `{required_dps}`. Initial status: `{confidence}`. Suggested file: `{filename}`. Local key, device ID, IP address, Cloud credentials and friendly names are not included. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
